children.name: Rejected invoice and reversal operations in SENT leave every counter unchanged
Approval and rejection actions update the live counters at every review level
APPROVING freezes suspendedAmountCents before suspended transactions are reassigned
An invoice update in EVALUATING updates both source and destination counters
SEND freezes initialAmountCents while the other applicable counters stay live
Invoice replacement and POSTPONE update CREATED counters correctly
REJECTED counters remain live and are not snapshots
CREATED counters immediately exclude a reversed transaction and an empty batch freezes zero
